signature: fn fill_from(a: &mut [i64], start: usize, v: i64) -> ()

accept.specs:
spec fn ref_pre(a: &[i64], start: usize, v: i64) -> bool { start <= a.len() }
spec fn ref_post(a: &[i64], b: &[i64], start: usize, v: i64) -> bool { a.len() == b.len() && (forall|k: usize| k < a.len() ==> ((k >= start ==> #[trigger] a[k] == v) && (k < start ==> a[k] == b[k]))) }
